# Australian Medical Council
> The Australian Medical Council accredits medical education and training, assesses international medical graduates, and supports medical registration standards in Australia.

The AMC is the national standards and assessment body for medical education and training in Australia. Its website includes pathways for international medical graduates, accreditation standards and reports, examinations, registration information, and corporate publications.

## International Medical Graduates
- [IMG overview](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/pathways/): Overview of AMC assessment pathways for international medical graduates.
- [Competent Authority Pathway](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/pathways/competent-authority-pathway/): Eligibility and process for the Competent Authority Pathway.
- [Standard Pathway](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/pathways/standard-pathway/): Requirements and steps for the Standard Pathway to registration.
- [Specialist Pathway](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/pathways/specialist-pathway/): Information for specialist international medical graduates seeking recognition.
- [Portfolio Pathway](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/pathways/portfolio-pathway/): Details of the Portfolio Pathway for selected non-specialist candidates.
- [Primary source verification](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/primary-source-verification/): Verification of medical qualifications through AMC processes.
- [English language requirements](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/english-language-requirements/): English language standards relevant to AMC assessment and registration pathways.

## Examinations and Assessment
- [Assessment overview](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/): Entry point for AMC assessment services and candidate information.
- [AMC CAT MCQ Examination](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/amc-examinations/cat-mcq-examination/): Format, eligibility, fees, and policies for the computer adaptive MCQ exam.
- [AMC Clinical Examination](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/amc-examinations/clinical-examination/): Clinical examination structure, requirements, and candidate guidance.
- [Workplace based assessment](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/workplace-based-assessment/): Approved workplace-based assessment programs and pathway information.
- [Examination calendar](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/exam-calendar/): Key dates for AMC examinations and assessment activities.
- [Examination fees](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/exam-fees/): Current fees for AMC examinations and related services.
- [Authorised test centres](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/amc-examinations/authorised-test-centres/): Locations and details for AMC-authorised examination centres.

## Accreditation
- [Accreditation overview](https://www.amc.org.au/accreditation/): Overview of AMC accreditation of medical education and training programs.
- [Medical schools](https://www.amc.org.au/accreditation/medical-schools/): Accreditation standards, processes, and reports for primary medical education.
- [Prevocational training](https://www.amc.org.au/accreditation/prevocational-training/): Accreditation information for intern and prevocational medical training.
- [Specialist medical programs](https://www.amc.org.au/accreditation/specialist-medical-programs/): Standards and accreditation processes for specialist education and training.
- [Assessment authorities](https://www.amc.org.au/accreditation/assessment-authorities/): Accreditation of authorities that assess overseas-trained specialists.
- [Accreditation standards](https://www.amc.org.au/accreditation/accreditation-standards/): Published standards used across AMC accreditation programs.
- [Accreditation reports](https://www.amc.org.au/accreditation/accreditation-reports/): Reports and outcomes from AMC accreditation assessments.

## Registration and Standards
- [Registration overview](https://www.amc.org.au/registration/): Information supporting medical registration pathways in Australia.
- [Medical Board of Australia](https://www.amc.org.au/registration/medical-board-of-australia/): Relationship between AMC processes and Medical Board registration.
- [Internship and general registration](https://www.amc.org.au/registration/internship-and-general-registration/): Guidance on internship completion and general registration requirements.
- [Specialist registration](https://www.amc.org.au/registration/specialist-registration/): Information relevant to specialist registration pathways.
- [Professional standards](https://www.amc.org.au/registration/professional-standards/): Standards and expectations relevant to medical practice and registration.

## Candidates and AMC Portfolio
- [AMC candidate portal](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/amc-portfolio/): Access point and information for the AMC candidate portfolio.
- [Create an AMC portfolio](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/amc-portfolio/create-an-amc-portfolio/): Steps to establish an AMC portfolio account.
- [Portfolio fees](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/amc-portfolio/fees/): Fees associated with AMC portfolio services.
- [Portfolio user guides](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/amc-portfolio/user-guides/): Practical guides for using the AMC portfolio system.
- [Candidate policies](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/candidate-policies/): Policies governing AMC candidates, examinations, and conduct.
- [Apply now](https://www.amc.org.au/assessment/apply-now/): Starting point for assessment applications and candidate actions.

- [Publications](https://www.amc.org.au/publications/): Central index of AMC reports, policies, standards, and corporate documents.
- [Annual reports](https://www.amc.org.au/publications/annual-reports/): AMC annual reports and organisational performance publications.
- [Policies](https://www.amc.org.au/publications/policies/): Corporate and operational policies published by the AMC.
- [Standards and procedures](https://www.amc.org.au/publications/standards-and-procedures/): Official standards, procedures, and guidance documents.
- [Forms](https://www.amc.org.au/publications/forms/): Downloadable forms for AMC processes and applications.
- [News](https://www.amc.org.au/news/): Updates, announcements, and recent AMC developments.

- [Contact us](https://www.amc.org.au/contact-us/): Contact details for AMC teams and enquiries.
